articles.description: Both incidents were caught on camera, and today Abdullah Khan (24) was jailed for six-and-a-half years by the Special Criminal Court

articles.title: Teenager’s TikTok video prompted U.S. warning of possible Moscow terrorist attack, Russia’s FSB says
articles.description: Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) said a teenager who posted a video on TikTok was the source of information about a planned terrorist attack in Moscow, a threat the U.S. Embassy had warned about the day before.

articles.title: Russia detains teen following U.S. tip about possible terrorist attack
articles.description: Russian authorities announced the detention of a teenager following a tip from U.S. law enforcement concerning a threat targeting a Moscow museum.
